newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday as investors remained jittery about violence in Karachi and Lahore and worried about the economy, dealers said.
"The economy is in recession and there is little investment coming in," dealer Sajad Mankani said. "Recent violence in Karachi, Lahore and other cities has also dampened sentiment."
The index fell 5.15 points, or 0.33 percent, to end at 1,566.12. Losers led gainers 182 to 119. Dewan Salman fell 0.80 rupees to 34.65. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
